scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml packages/ui/node_modules packages/docs/node_modules packages/app-extension/node_modules packages/dev/node_modules packages/dev/.quasar
scripts.build: pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:docs
scripts.ci:publish: pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-ui-qmarkdown publish --access public --publish-branch dev && pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-app-extension-qmarkdown publish --access public --publish-branch dev
scripts.ci:publish:beta: pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-ui-qmarkdown publish --access public --publish-branch v3-beta --tag beta --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @quasar/quasar-app-extension-qmarkdown publish --access public --publish-branch v3-beta --tag beta --no-git-checks
